newsitem.title: USA: VTX Electronics to merge with Elcan.
newsitem.headline: VTX Electronics to merge with Elcan.

text.p: VTX Electronics Corp said on Friday that it has entered a tentative agreement to merge with Elcan Technologies Corp, a privately held company.
VTX intends to acquire Elcan's net assets by issuing a combination of preferred stock and other debt and equity securities.

Scott Cannold, the president and principal owner of Elcan Technologies, will become the chief executive officer of the combined entity and Albert Roth, the current chairman and chief executive officer of VTX Electronics Corp., will continue as chairman.
The companies were competitors in the elctronic components and cable products markets, VTX said.
The companies expect their combined customer base to exceed $50 million in annual revenues, VTX said.
The transaction is subject to the negotiation and execution of a definitive agreement, approval of the board of directors of each company, and consent of the secured lenders of VTX, the company said.
